author: Isaiah M.
body: I really love this soap so I’m definitely gonna buy another one next week I had razor bumps all over the bottom of my face and when I used the Earthly Derm Soap them razor bumps was gone within 2 weeks later and now my face is glowing and shiny ✨ as a 22 year old young black male I really recommend this soap this is really good for us as black people 👌🏾so if you wanna see a change to your skin get the soap it works 💙

author: Shannon J.
body: I love this soap. I can already see and feel the difference.

author: Janis J.
body:
I love the soap, my only issue is that that the brown spot is still there.
I love the glow!!!!

author: Nicole G.
body: My first experience with this product was at my boyfriend’s house. I have to admit, I thought; “what do boys know about skincare?” lol. But he introduced this to me with such an excitement, it was too cute to brush off. Said he loved it for his in grown hairs/razor bumps. The first time I used this product I didn’t expect much. But I couldn’t help but notice how soft my face and hands felt! After using it several times… I noticed my blemish and acne scars gone and my skin so much brighter and softer! Hand to God I ordered by the bundle after that because I REFUSE to run out! No Sephora cleanser has ever made me as happy as this one! Shout out to my man, and the amazing team behind the scene putting their heart in this product. It definitely shows! 🫶🏼

author: Janine J.
body: I’m really pleased with this product. I’ve been trying for some time to find a way to lessen the increasing dark spots along my cheeks. This is my first time trying this soap. I don’t have any before picture but trust me it works! Not only have I been happy with the results I am also seeing a significant change under my eyes, which I was not really expecting. Beyond that it is so creamy and feels luxurious on my skin. I could not be more satisfied.

author: Willetta W.
body: Well it's been about 2 weeks and I see a difference in my face. My dark spots are almost gone already. I didn't do b4 and after pics but I wish I had. I really didn't expect much and thought I would not be doing a review. It does actually work for those that may be as skeptical as I was. I thought it was overpriced but it's worth it if you want better looking skin with less- no darks spots.

author: Carolyn P.

author: Karl Y.
body:
100/100 perfection! My friend from the UK recommended this bar to me and it’s been the best blessing ever! I’ve suffered from deep hyperpigmentation for years and after numerous dermatologist visits, treatments and failed skincare products, I’ve finally found something simple but effective. Not only
has my inflamed skin drastically reduced, my pigment has evened out better than ever and actually brightened my overall tone. I’m pretty locked in at this point and will keep yall in business single handedly if I have to! It’s been one of my best investments in myself to date!

Used it for 5 days and already see a amazing difference. 
I recommend this soap.. Can't wait to see my face in 4 weeks. My face has lighten up so much.i had dark pigmentation very bad.

author: Brandi M.
body: I love it now! When I first got it I had high expectations and was a little disappointed but Patienceeee. Month 3-4 is when I can say it started to really notice scars faded. I use it faithful morning and night.  Straight bar works best for me. I cut mine in fours and rub the bar on, it lathers really well. Then I work it for a few minutes and rinse with cold water. If you cut the bars they last as described, whole they don’t.

body: It's working good so far my acne scars fading a bit ..I should take pictures before I started but nevertheless I'll take some as it progresses

author: Claire B.
body: My 1st batch wasn't that good as the soap won't lather well. So I was a little skeptical about ordering another one. To my surprise, the soaps lather a lot and I love it. The smell is subtle and very pleasant. I will be ordering more when it's time for a refill

author: Carey V.
body:
I’m a lucky girlie who has dealt with horrendous polycystic acne since I was a kid and, in the last few years, rosacea as well.  I have tried every topical, med, and expensive product known to man to combat it, with livable results but nothing miraculous.  Enter EarthlyDerm!  I only used it because my husband is black and loves what it does for his skin irritation when he shaves his head.

Consider my mind blown.  I would have never thought that a bar soap would clear up my acne but more importantly my persistent rosacea.  This stuff really works!
